notes.title: August 12th Update Notes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108834/2485fe63c35f8a90546d1b7994d968e0a61e98d7.png[/img]
[previewyoutube=W4Jw0gYX9ac;full][/previewyoutube]
This game update focuses on new content, system improvements, and an overall enhanced gaming experience.
The details are as follows:
[Update Details]

Major Updates

Mode Update
-Survival Mode-
In Survival Mode, you must survive by defeating incoming enemies.
After 20 minutes, the final boss appears, and defeating the final boss clears the stage.
A boss appears every 4 minutes after the start.
If you fail to defeat a boss within the time limit, the bosses will accumulate, increasing the difficulty, so be careful.
When the game ends, the scores are recorded on the scoreboard in descending order.

Card List Additional Update
New buffs and attack abilities have been added to the card system.
-Movement Speed Increase
A buff that increases Serke's movement speed has been added.
Movement speed can be increased by up to 40%.
-Attack Ability
Attack abilities have been added to the card list.
If you select an attack ability card, you can use it in that stage even if it's not equipped in your abilities.
-LV2 Attack Ability Added
An enhanced form of the attack ability, LV2, has been added.
LV2 can only be used by selecting a card.

Detailed Update Contents

-Challenge Mode
The stage selection image for Time Attack has been modified.
-Enemy Addition
A mine with a slow effect has been added.
Claymore has been added.
-Visuals
'Management Device' display effect has been added to the lobby section.
A guide arrow has been added to the tutorial map's 이동지점 (movement point).
The range of the practice enemy for the tutorial counter has been reduced.
A directional arrow has been added to some areas of Stage 2-3.
A title text has been added to the status display screen when paused.
The mash effect that appears when an enemy is hit has been modified.
All hit effects that appear when an enemy is hit have been modified.
The board status UI in the setup menu has been changed.
Stats that increase when a chipset is equipped are displayed in green, and stats that decrease are displayed in red.
Overdrive effect improved: The effect has been changed to make it clearer that Overdrive is in use when activated.
When activated, an 'in-use' effect is displayed on the UI.
The card system's 'Reset' text has been changed to 'Reroll' and placed in a more visible location.
-Bugs
Fixed an issue where the sound effects did not work correctly when Challenge Mode was activated.
-Convenience
Modified so that menus are not selected immediately on the title screen.
Changed so that you can click to check ability options without selecting a slot in Abilities.
Changed to select slots by operating the Q and E keys instead of the movement keys.
Unavailable cost values are displayed in red.
-Controller Button Changes
Basic attack has been changed from the RB button to the A button.
When attacking an enemy with Rifle and Gatling modes, you will now face the direction of the nearest enemy.
The weapon change button has been changed from the B button to the RB button.
The dash dodge button has been changed from the A button to the B button.
For those using a custom controller, resetting will change the buttons to the modified ones.
-Balance
Gatling mode damage has been slightly reduced.
SP recovery amount has been increased for melee weapon normal attacks.
Overdrive gauge charge amount has been increased for melee weapon attacks.
The cooldowns of melee weapon skills have been slightly reduced.
The value of the melee weapon attack power increase buff in card selection has been increased.
The abilities and prices of some abilities have been adjusted.
The stats of stage bosses have been increased.
-Sound
The sound effect that plays when hit by an ability attack has been changed.
The sound effect that plays when an enemy is hit by a Halberd skill attack has been changed.
The sound effect for the Halberd skill 'Ground Pound' has been changed.
-Optimization
The issue of frame drops when holding a large number of boards and chipsets has been partially fixed.
An audio mixer has been added, so sound no longer overlaps and amplifies.

notes.title: April 16th Minor Patch Notes
notes.content:
Here are the small patch notes for April 16, 2025.

system
card buff
When selecting a card buff, it has been modified so that even if you repeatedly press the space bar, the card will not be selected until all cards appear.

Status Information
A feature has been added to display status related to the current state when the Pause screen is displayed during a stage.

Sorting of Equipped Inventory
The board and chipset inventory has been changed so that the currently selected or equipped board or chipset is prioritized.
You no longer need to scroll down the inventory to enhance the equipped chipset and board.

notes.title: April 10 Patch Notes
notes.content:
April 10 Patch Notes
Here are the April 10, 2025 Patch Notes.

Balance

The charge attack range of Red Crow's 'Charge Burst' has been increased.

It increases by 40% compared to the half-charge range.
It increases by 50% compared to the full-charge range.

Added Enemies

A superior entity of the self-destructing enemy has been added.
The entity does not self-destruct but attacks in range.

Content

Time Attack mode has been added.
Time Attack has Normal and Hard difficulties, and progress records are saved by difficulty.

System
The rank display method in the main stage settlement is displayed in more detail.
Ranks related to clear time are displayed.
Ranks related to damage received are displayed.
After acquiring damage nullification through the buff system, a nullification effect occurs when taking damage. When Overdrive is available, an effect will appear on the Overdrive usage counter.

notes.title: New Update Preview-1-
notes.content:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108834/38e06fd9576527286e2600a907a2519a56bfce40.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108834/80ed35234f1e333f6801e22a12ca613c31c67363.jpg[/img][/url]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108834/072e22eb3c3c5a2b753e31418c924c4ee87f6aa3.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45108834/25bfb6ea708cf86d76cbb1f8fa882d272d744117.jpg[/img][/url]

Hello. I am the developer 'EV'.

Thank you to everyone who purchased Serke.

And I would like to briefly introduce the first content that I will update in the future.

The first update is Time Attack Mode.

Time Attack Mode is a mode that clears multiple waves as quickly as possible.

When you clear this mode, the 5 fastest records will be displayed in the mode selection screen.

Of course, the weapons used at the time of clearing will also be displayed in the record.

It may be a small update, but I hope that the mode that will be added this time will be content that will make the game more enjoyable.

This update is in development, and more details about it can be found in the game after the update.

Thank you for reading.

notes.title: February 28, 2025 Update Notes
notes.content:
Here is the translation of the update content for February 28, 2025:

---

1. Pad Customization Feature Added
 A feature has been added that allows users to customize the pad buttons according to their preferences.

2. Move to Lobby After Normal Mode Ending
 After completing the normal mode ending, instead of going to the title screen, the game now moves to the lobby.

3. Basic Attack Button Control Change
 Previous: 1 attack per button press.  
 Now: Continuous attacks occur while holding down the button.

4. Move to Lobby After Clearing Stage 5-2 
 After clearing Stage 5-2 for the first time, the game now moves to the lobby instead of the title screen.

5. Balance Adjustments
-Healing Orbs: Healing amount has been reduced.  
-Health Recovery on Basic Attack Hit: Now, health is recovered when a basic attack hits.

Ability Changes
- Drain Plunder: HP recovery on hit increased from 7% of HP (cooldown 15 seconds) → Recovery amount doubles on basic attack hit.  
- Battle Flow: SP recovery on hit increased from 40 SP (cooldown 15 seconds) → SP recovery amount doubles on basic attack hit.  
- Auto Repair: Recovery amount increased from 2% to 4%.  
- Inner Peace: Recovery amount increased from 15 to 25.  
- Counter Ability: Expanded description range and damage increased.

6. Ability Balance Adjustments
- Combat Instinct: Attack power increase changed from 50 to 100.  
- Iron Barricade: Defense increase changed from 250 to 130.  
- Attack Vitalizer: Health increase based on attack power changed from 20% to 50%.  
- Armored Synchronized: Health increase based on defense power changed from 15% to 25%.  
- Bastion: Defense increase based on health changed from 15% to 12%.  
- Tyrant: Defense increase based on attack power changed from 25% to 40%.

7. Ability Price Changes
- Life Extension, Combat Instinct, Iron Barricade: Price increased from 4500 to 6000.  
- Vitality Boost, Power Amplifier, Stone Heart: Price increased from 7000 to 9000.

8. Bug Fixes
 A problem where data was applied incorrectly in some countries has been fixed.
